limits: The full Kubernetes/CSI/Candidate worker live path, whole-node reboot and power-loss persistence were not tested in this increment.
The reaper runs only on its trusted host spool and current boot. It retries original expiry termination, never replays execution or grants a replacement.
A stopped service waits for systemd watchdog detection. Filesystem/kernel stalls and scan backlog can further delay enforcement; primary fixed-deadline guards remain required.
No storage drainage, durable membership/admission seal, writer release or accepted execution output. Execution remains Unknown, writer Draining.
Service health is not yet coupled to database startup admission; multi-node routing, automated retention/capacity and production deployment certification remain pending.
The host operator, runtime and private spool remain trusted. Product T01–T43 remains not_run.
